text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—The first leg of the Triple Tiara. You 
probably already know the result from the 
TV, right? I managed to give it my all. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha-san's running is so powerful 
and mesmerizing, you can't take your eyes 
off her. I really thought she was a true 
'City Girl.'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I want to amaze everyone with my running 
too! At the next race, the Yushun Himba, 
for sure!"
